report.answer_text: The NFL’s London games are played at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium or Wembley Stadium, depending on the matchup. In 2026, Tottenham hosted Colts–Commanders on October 4 and Eagles–Jaguars on October 11. Wembley hosted Texans–Jaguars on October 18. (operations.nfl.com)
